title: Precinct of Mut
summary: A separate southern sacred precinct, with a horseshoe-shaped lake and several temples, extends Karnak beyond the Amun enclosure.

claims.text: The Isheru surrounds Mut’s temple on three sides and belongs to the distinctive sacred landscape of Eye-of-Re goddesses.
Temple A and the Ramesses III temple entered the enclosure through later expansions; they were not all originally inside one boundary.

citations.locator: Temple A and Ramesses III paragraphs

claims.text: Excavations west of the Taharqa Gate exposed older paving below later Ptolemaic occupation, illustrating changes in circulation and use.

citations.locator: pp. 1–3, Excavation west of the Taharqa Gate

caveats: This is not the Ramesses III bark temple in the Amun Great Court.
Current access and transport between precincts need separate verification.
